parsed_json.up: Select chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mesh_heading, first_approval from molecule_dictionary. Inner join drug_indication on molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno to get indication headings. Inner join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno to get canonical SMILES. Filter molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4 for approved drugs. Return DISTINCT rows over the requested output columns. Sort by first_approval descending (most recent first).
